scope: Isolated native dense overlay; preserve the working VIO, LCD, DPGO underlay and existing experiment outputs.
reference_status: Explicit compatibility port: installed modern PGMO API at immutable commit; not the official Kimera-Multi v1.0.0 PGMO manifest combination.

source_bundle.architecture_policy: Source-only; independently compile ARM64 and x86-64. No binary copy between hosts.
patches_included: Kimera-Semantics kimera_semantics_ros CMake requires C++14 for PCL 1.10
gflags_catkin exports the existing system ABI-compatible gflags library
minkindr_python/CATKIN_IGNORE excludes unused optional Python bindings

source_supplement.reason: ros-noetic-disparity-image-proc is not in the Noetic final binary repository; preserve the AMOV source runtime dependency.

abi.GTSAM: Reuse existing 4.2.0 and gtsam_unstable with matching Eigen and tangent-preintegration settings
abi.OpenCV: Reuse 4.2; AMOV has explicitly isolated 4.2 instead of host 4.5
abi.dense_languages: PGMO/config_utilities/spatial_hash use C++17; Semantics ROS uses C++14
abi.critical_exchange_gate: PoseGraph/PoseGraphNode/PoseGraphEdge MD5 must remain unchanged after sourcing overlay; cross-check against both-host definition locks.

workspace.layout: merged devel; do not use install-only runtime because upstream omits voxblox_mesh_frontend_node from install(TARGETS)
workspace.parallelism: One package at a time, at most two compiler jobs; native test build one compiler job. Reduce to one if memory pressure.

build_dependency_traps: Build voxblox_msgs explicitly before PGMO ROS: upstream declares it as exec_depend and find_package(voxblox_msgs QUIET) controls the native Voxblox frontend.
Force CMake PGMO ROS after voxblox_msgs; require actual voxblox_mesh_frontend_node executable.
Use voxblox_mesh_frontend_node for voxblox_msgs/Mesh, not generic mesh_frontend_node expecting KimeraPgmoMesh.
Modern PGMO MESH mode consumes dense ordered Path index as key; full original key IDs and gaps must be verified before runtime integration.
Do not use stale v1 numeric run_mode launch or the old LIO-based metric_mesh_adapter.py.
AMOV OpenCV_DIR and CMAKE_PROJECT_INCLUDE must remain its native isolated 4.2 baseline when rebuilding ROS modules.
acceptance_after_build: Actual sourced rospack paths point to intended overlay
Native PGMO, Voxblox frontend, Semantics node and TSDF executable have no missing shared libraries
Exchanged PoseGraph MD5 unchanged and both-host compatible
Upstream tests results retained; failures are diagnosed rather than suppressed
Build success alone does not certify live native TSDF wiring, keyframe associations, PGMO deformation or dual-host fusion
